purpose: Repeat the same-process async worker regression at the corrected candidate and add an explicit paused-reader heartbeat negative control.
interpretation: A confirmatory regression comparison after diagnostic runs v1/v2, not a preregistered research study.

environment.workers: 2 execute workers, 1 verifier; one producer and one consumer

secondary_heartbeat_regression.pre_fix_expected: fail because paused iter_steps holds the same-store lock
secondary_heartbeat_regression.fixed_expected: pass; heartbeat completes while consumer is paused
secondary_heartbeat_regression.execution_note: The test is copied into a clean pre-fix checkout for the negative control; it is run from the fixed checkout for the positive control.

limits: The primary timeout is right-censored and must not be described as a measured speedup.
One Apple M1 Pro host and one bounded-backlog test; no large-workload throughput, CPU, or memory claim.
The connection mutex coordinates only one TrajectoryStore instance in one process.
This is systems correctness evidence, not model learning or capability evidence.
